steps.text: 分析 容易想到作变量代换 $t = \arcsin \sqrt{x}$ ，但计算却较困难；若用上题评注中给出的积分公式就比较简单了.

$$
\begin{array}{r l} & {I = \frac {1}{2} \int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {\arcsin \sqrt {x} + \arcsin \sqrt {1 - x}}{\sqrt {1 - x (1 - x)}} \mathrm{d} x} \\ & {\quad = \frac {\pi}{4} \int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {1}{\sqrt {1 - x (1 - x)}} \mathrm{d} x \quad \left(\because \arcsin t + \arcsin \sqrt {1 - t ^ {2}} = \frac {\pi}{2}, \text {这里} t = \sqrt {x}\right)} \\ & {\quad = \frac {\pi}{4} \int_ {0} ^ {1} \frac {1}{\sqrt {\frac {3}{4} + \left(x - \frac {1}{2}\right) ^ {2}}} \mathrm{d} x = \frac {\pi}{4} \ln \left(\left(x - \frac {1}{2}\right) + \sqrt {\frac {3}{4} + \left(x - \frac {1}{2}\right) ^ {2}}\right) \Bigg | _ {0} ^ {1} = \frac {\pi}{4} \ln 3.} \end{array}

cdps.prompt: 定积分换元时新上下限如何确定？对称换元是否可用？
cdps.expected: 换元同步改限，或用对称性简化。
